## J1 交付

- 固定 Host 慢写端的取消用例。写端替身缓冲整帧、drain 尚未完成时取消观察者。实际 HostEndpoint 返回完整 H5，重放原请求返回同一结果且只派发一次。
- 真实 Agent Service、Unix-socket Harness channel 和 Beebou 子进程跑有工具的普通轮。模型替身先发前导文字，留在同一调用内等待，再返回工具调用。Mobile 替身只收到第一代草稿，终态与提交的最终消息均采用最终 H5 回复的内容。
- 确认现有 Host 取消路径满足本组用例。更新注释和启用告警，明确生产配对需要包含 MG1 的 Model Gateway 精确版本。默认配置为 `progress_with_tools=false`。

## 验证

- macOS ARM64 / Python 3.12.13，从 `03c1a6a00d16afc3e1046e963d267de3c05ae68c` 运行受影响的 AS 选集，108 PASS。全量 Beebou 505 PASS。
- `tools/architecture/check.py --policy docs/implementations/migration/module-ownership.json --root .` 检查 272/272 文件，0 发现。 `git diff --check` PASS。
- 全量 AS 用 `psutil 7.2.2` 补齐测试环境后运行 3,439 项，3,431 PASS、3 skip、5 预期失败。保留前两次尝试的 `psutil` 导入失败记录。
- AS 组件 ST 走实际 Host、Backend、Unix-socket Channel 和 Beebou。模型、工具、Mobile、Store 权限端口及入站接线使用原有具名替身。取消用例使用实际 HostEndpoint 和可阻塞 drain 的写端替身。真实 MG1 producer 配对和生产运行 NOT_RUN，待 #2793 与启用工作验证。

Refs #2790, #2542, #2565.

```text
Lane: B
Issue: #2790   RFC: #2542   ADR: n/a — 当前工作验证现有 AS 约定
Design: n/a — 现有 H5/H5p 和 H7/H8 公开形状
Spec: docs/implementations/contracts/server-agent-service-harness-model-stream-v3.1.md
Design review: n/a — 现有 AS-I45 与 #2793 已记录的 P3-2/3/4 跟进
IDs implemented: AS-I45, STR-T4, STR-T8
Tests: STR-T4 -> tests/server/agent_service/test_as_hostapi_model_progress.py::test_cancel_during_drain_keeps_the_buffered_prefix_and_authoritative_reply, STR-T8 -> tests/server/agent_service/test_as_st_t10_beebou_process.py::test_str_t4_t8_tool_progress_is_voided_before_the_final_reply
Source: main 36d313eae3849ea566eb2573487947555b2e2f95 / head 03c1a6a00d16afc3e1046e963d267de3c05ae68c, Harness H5 入口，测试显式启用 progress_with_tools
Ownership: Agent Service Host / 每次调用的观察者和临时 H5p / H5、H5p、ASModelProxy.dispatch / #2542 L3 J1
Placement: server/agent_service/backend/host_api 与 server/agent_service；ownership registration n/a — 接口和依赖未新增
Transition: MG1 #2793 属 Model Gateway；AS 启用与精确生产配对待会签
Verification: AS 受影响 unittest -> PASS (108)，Beebou pytest -> PASS (505)，架构扫描 -> PASS (272/272)，全量 AS unittest -> PASS (3431 PASS，3 skip，5 预期失败)；两次环境不全 -> FAIL (psutil 导入)，真实 MG1 和生产 -> NOT_RUN
Self-review: DEV-01..DEV-15 checked; AS 会签、跨 lane 评审和适用 CI 待完成
```

/kind feature

Refs #2597 (L2-B), #2542, #2113. Read-side companion to merged #2781 BFR and merged #2782 BAO; **stacked on #2797**. This candidate does not close any Issue.

### Scope
- Reuse the existing Store-local candidate relation and its original receipt decoder from #2797. Provide private ordinary TaskRef lookup and bounded dispatcher task-ref pages in a caller-owned read snapshot.
- Return only original retained pending-task facts, not a consumed input, generated Run, terminal result, report obligation, or authority decision. The private cursor is internal iteration state, not a published ReportOwner cursor.
- No new schema, mapping, writer, public/exported method, plugin integration, authorization policy, execution path, or production opener. No changes to existing tests or gates.
- ReportOwner and BeebouTurnFacts production binding remain unimplemented pending the respective reviewed owner read/promotion/terminal contracts. No claims of Bee Hello World integration.
- This PR targets the dependency branch for an independent two-file review. Retarget to main only after #2797 is merged and same-base checks pass. Do not merge into the dependency branch.

### Evidence
- Linux CPython 3.12.14 scoped source overlay of #2797 latest head `e533d4a55ee1168d53d2477077abe62b41b11f19` + this PR head `396385466233639fd1fa6ee1ef76022789c97735`; dependency schema/proxy/test blobs verified against GitHub. Earlier 9e9a526e candidate had 6/6 pass; after the composed staging prerequisite was introduced, the fixture now opens the existing owner transaction explicitly.
- `PYTHONPATH=tests/server python -B -W error::ResourceWarning -m unittest -v agent_service.test_bot_pending_task_reads agent_service.test_bot_pending_catalog agent_service.test_original_selection_schema`: **7/7 PASS** (two new positive read tests, four parent catalog tests, one original-selection regression).
- Real SQLite candidate catalog and Store-internal row fixture writer; read by TaskRef and page after file reopen with SQLite query_only, original input/source and queued state retained, no new Run or writes. Empty catalog gives an empty internal page.
- Fixture ordinary data is not a production admission, actual task scheduling, actual consumed-input observation, terminal/report or device acceptance. BFR-T1–T4 actual consuming integration remains BLOCKED/NOT_RUN. Applicable CI not run locally.
- Trace checker: BLOCKED (lane A editable design and Issue design-review receipt absent; ADR pending). Keep Draft until those prerequisites are met.

```text
Lane: A
Issue: #2597   RFC: #2113
ADR: n/a — no new owner decision, internal read candidate only
Design: n/a — merged BFR Markdown exists; no public signature or UI change
Design review: merged #2781 BFR scope; exact candidate owner implementation review pending
Spec: docs/implementations/contracts/agent-service-hive-factual-reads-v1.md

Tests: BFR-T2 -> tests/server/agent_service/test_bot_pending_task_reads.py::test_retained_tasks_read_by_ref_and_page_after_reopen (prerequisite only); additional empty catalog positive case; 7/7 scoped tests
Source: dependency #2797 exact tested base e533d4a55ee1168d53d2477077abe62b41b11f19; candidate head 396385466233639fd1fa6ee1ef76022789c97735; main a5c12ac3e5e902cc5c3235274708c54ccadb81c6
Ownership: existing Session Store owner, no additional state writer
Placement: server/agent_service/session_store/_pending_task_reads.py; corresponding Store unit tests
Transition: private candidate; production profile unchanged
Verification: actual producer/consumer integration BLOCKED/NOT_RUN
Self-review: no public API, authorization logic, execution path or gate change
```
